messages.trackingConversionZero: Ad activity was detected, but conversions are reported as zero. Check conversion tracking.
messages.trackingRevenueZero: Conversions were recorded, but revenue is reported as zero. Check revenue tracking.

possibleCauses: The conversion tag or Conversion API may not be collecting events correctly.
A landing-page or completion-page change may be causing conversion events to be missed.
There may be a reporting discrepancy between the ad platform and actual order or inquiry data.
actions: Check the ad platform conversion-tracking status and recent tag changes.
Compare actual order or inquiry data with ad-platform conversion data.
Test whether the completion-page or Conversion API event fires correctly.
Avoid sharp budget increases for the affected campaign until tracking is verified.

possibleCauses: Conversions may be occurring without a revenue value being passed.
The revenue or currency parameter may be missing from the purchase-complete event.
There may be an issue connecting ad-platform revenue with the order system.
actions: First confirm whether conversions exist while only revenue is zero.
Check the value and currency parameters on the purchase-complete event.
Compare ad-platform revenue with actual order revenue.
Avoid ROAS-based budget decisions until revenue tracking is restored.

possibleCauses: Conversions may have fallen, or more spend may be required to generate the same number of conversions.
Higher CPC may have increased cost per conversion.
Lower CVR may have reduced click-to-conversion efficiency.
Missing conversion tracking may also be making CPA appear higher than it actually is.
actions: Review CPC, CVR, and conversion volume together with CPA to isolate the cause.
Check for recent changes to creatives, search terms, targeting, or bidding.
Verify that conversion tracking is operating normally.
If performance deterioration persists, consider reducing or reallocating campaign budget.

possibleCauses: Revenue growth may have been insufficient relative to the increase in ad spend.
Revenue itself may have declined.
CPA may have increased while CVR declined.
A revenue-tracking issue may be causing revenue to be underreported.
actions: Determine whether higher ad spend or lower revenue is the larger driver.
Review CPA, CVR, CPC, and conversion volume together.
Check the revenue-tracking status.
If the anomaly persists, consider freezing or reducing the affected campaign budget.

possibleCauses: Landing-page conversion efficiency after the ad click may have declined.
The quality of incoming audiences or search terms may have changed.
There may be an issue with the page, checkout, or inquiry flow.
actions: Verify that the landing page and conversion flow are working correctly.
Review recent changes in search-term and audience traffic quality.
Compare CVR changes by device and campaign.
Consider adjusting creatives or targeting where performance remains weak.

possibleCauses: Creative response may have weakened.
The audience or placement mix may have changed.
Ad fatigue may have increased.
actions: Compare recent CTR by creative.
Check whether impression growth and CTR decline occurred at the same time.
Consider replacing low-performing creatives or testing new ones.

possibleCauses: Increased competition may have raised click costs.
Bid settings or the automated bidding strategy may have changed.
Lower CTR may have reduced advertising efficiency.
actions: Check for recent bidding-setting changes.
Review CPC and CTR changes together.
Identify high-CPC segments by search term, audience, or placement.
Consider bid or budget adjustments in high-cost, low-efficiency segments.

possibleCauses: Conversion volume or average order value may have declined.
The quality of advertising traffic may have deteriorated.
Some revenue-tracking data may be missing.
actions: Review conversion volume, CPA, and ROAS together.
Compare actual order revenue with ad-platform revenue.
Check whether the decline is concentrated in specific campaigns or products.

possibleCauses: Click volume may have fallen or CVR may have declined.
A conversion-tracking issue may have occurred.
Ad traffic or landing-page performance may have weakened.
actions: Review click volume and CVR together.
Check the conversion-tracking status.
Inspect the landing page and key conversion paths.

possibleCauses: Recent advertising performance moved outside its normal reference range.
Changes in ad settings, market conditions, or data aggregation may be contributing factors.
actions: Compare related metrics over the same period.
Check for recent campaign-setting changes.
Review additional data to determine whether the anomaly persists.
